snippet.title: Command the Chaos. Control the Battle. | Hell Of War: Combined Arms
snippet.description:
Command the battlefield from above, coordinate your forces in real time, and take direct control when the chaos begins.

Hell Of War: Combined Arms is a tactical FPS/RTS hybrid where strategy, drones, infantry, vehicles and direct combat collide in one battlefield.
